assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Supplier-onboarding procedure and supplier-facing guide content
assessments.rationale: Organizes invoices and payment records, but does not provide a supplier-onboarding guide with sequential onboarding, exceptions, required approvals, or revision control.
Covers security prior-art research rather than preparing a supplier-facing onboarding guide; it cannot supply the requested document workflow or content.
Extracts existing meeting commitments; it does not author or format a supplier-onboarding guide with the requested onboarding controls.

Provides document creation plus an SOP structure explicitly covering purpose, use conditions, numbered steps, edge cases, and revision date and owner; it can create the editable guide and export it for printing without changing access.
Coordinates multi-agent work rather than creating a supplier guide, and supplies no document template or supplier-onboarding workflow.
Facilitates sprint retrospectives rather than supplier onboarding; it does not create the requested supplier-facing guide or approval workflow.
Creates follow-up tasks, which conflicts with the prompt; it cannot produce the editable printed supplier guide.
Manages Drive files and permissions but does not author the requested supplier-onboarding SOP content; its sharing guidance also includes access changes excluded.
